changes: Default Nano Banana generation and editing now use asynchronous media tasks
Submission retries reuse one idempotency key; polling handles all transient 5xx including 524
Accepted task receipts persist in logs; resume_omnia_image_task only queries and downloads an existing task
limitations: Original synchronous requests without task IDs cannot be recovered locally
Existing task recovery returns image results and does not rerun a complete multi-stage workflow
The legacy synchronous adapter used by explicit-size canvas requests remains unchanged
